name: [🌸SPRING] The Pee Game 🚽
desc:
📜 This is a funny simulator game about unleashing your pee power, unlocking unique pee skins, and competing with friends to see who can dominate the leaderboard!

⚠️ Watch out — the competition is fierce, and only the best will claim the top ranks!

Unlock crazy pee skins and sizes to stand out!
Buy drinks to boost your pee power!
Compete for the highest rank on the leaderboard!
Become the ultimate Pee Champion!
